objects.name: Constable Briggs
objects.greeting: Evening. Mind how you go - the fog comes up off the river quick of a night.|Westminster's the clock behind me. The bridges are east: the iron one, then the Tower Bridge at the Pool.
objects.topics: The Yard=The Constabulary's just along the Embankment. Inspector Hale runs it, when he's not chasing the Wharf gang.; The city=Strand runs east to the City. Oxford Street's north, past Holborn. You'll find the station and the airship field up there.

objects.name: Inspector Hale
objects.greeting: Inspector Hale. You have the look of someone who can handle themselves.

objects.title: The Wharf gang
objects.offer: A gang has the old wharf on the south bank, west of the bridges. Cargo goes missing, watchmen go in the river. Six of them. Clear them out and the Yard will see you right.
objects.remind: Over the Westminster bridge and west along the Bankside. Mind the fires.
objects.thanks: Six. The wharf's quiet for the first time in a month. Here - with the Yard's thanks.
objects.reward: coins x150, greater health potion x2, scroll of warding x1

objects.name: Stationmaster Pell
objects.greeting: The 7:40 to the north leaves on time or I'll know why.|Mind the gap between the platform and the train.

objects.name: Ada Lovelock
objects.greeting: Have you seen the dome from the inside? The whispers carry right round the gallery.
objects.topics: The museum=They have an orrery that runs by steam. You must see it.

objects.title: A letter for the station
objects.offer: Would you take a letter to the Stationmaster at the station on Oxford Street? My brother comes in on the night train and I want a cab waiting.
objects.remind: The station is north, up the avenue past the museum.
objects.thanks: He has it? You are a dear. Take this for your trouble.

objects.name: Mr Tolliver
objects.greeting: Fresh from the country this morning! Well - yesterday.
objects.stock: berry tart x12, hunters stew x6, roast meat x6, grilled fish x6, wild berries x10

objects.name: Old Nell
objects.greeting: Violets, lovely violets! A penny a bunch, and luck with every one.

objects.name: Captain Ferris
objects.greeting: She's the Albion, and she flies at dawn if the wind holds.|Seen the city from up there? The fog lies like a sea, the spires stick out of it like masts.

objects.name: Dr Quillon
objects.greeting: The museum closes at dusk, but the curators never seem to leave.
objects.stock: scroll of insight x2, scroll of return x4, parchment x10, ink x6, crystal ball x1

objects.name: Wiggins
objects.greeting: Paper! Paper! Read all about it - airship spotted over the Pool!

objects.name: Bertha Crumb
objects.greeting: They raise the road for the tall ships. Stand well back when the bell goes.

objects.name: Gaffer Moles
objects.greeting: Ironworks don't sleep. Neither do I, much.
